disclaimer: This summary is for convenience. The issuer MITC prevails. New sourcing has stopped; existing holders keep benefits. Product-page changes are flagged from 15 May 2026.

annual.summary: The renewal fee is ₹2,500 plus tax.

annual_waiver.summary: The MITC family table lists a waiver around ₹3 lakh of annual spend for Regalia. Confirm the personal MITC PDF for the exact waiver row.

base_earn.summary: The card earns 4 reward points per ₹200 of retail spend. The MITC lists a cycle cap of 50,000 reward points.

accelerated.summary: SmartBuy advertises up to 5X on flights, hotels, and vouchers. PayZapp extra cashback on utilities is marketing copy.

upi.notes: Checked issuer MITC and product materials on 2026-10-04; this benefit is not offered for this SKU.

redemption.summary: Points redeem through SmartBuy and NetBanking. Typical HDFC grids on related Gold pages use about ₹0.50 on flights and hotels, about ₹0.35 on catalogue, and about ₹0.20 on statement credit. Confirm whether Regalia uses the same grid.

expiry.summary: Reward points are typically valid for two years. Unused accounts for more than 365 days nullify points.

summary.summary: Domestic lounge is voucher-based. International access is delivered through Priority Pass. Priority Pass visits inside India are charged. Spend in a calendar quarter gates domestic vouchers. Completing at least four transactions unlocks international Priority Pass visits.

domestic.summary: Primary and add-on holders can receive up to 2 lounge vouchers per quarter.

conditions.summary: Spend at least ₹1 lakh in the calendar quarter.

international.summary: Primary and add-on holders can receive up to 6 complimentary visits per year outside India through Priority Pass.

conditions.summary: Priority Pass is issued after at least 4 transactions.
Priority Pass visits inside India are charged at USD 27 plus tax per the MITC.
